chat_attachment_storage_check.name: chat_attachment_storage_check
chat_attachment_storage_check.value: "chat_attachment"."s3_key" IS NOT NULL OR "chat_attachment"."vault_path" IS NOT NULL

custom_field_member_scope_check.name: custom_field_member_scope_check
custom_field_member_scope_check.value: ("custom_field"."field_type" = 'member') = ("custom_field"."member_scope" IS NOT NULL) AND ("custom_field"."member_scope" IS NULL OR "custom_field"."member_scope" IN ('all', 'humans', 'agents'))

initiative_attachment_storage_check.name: initiative_attachment_storage_check
initiative_attachment_storage_check.value: "initiative_attachment"."s3_key" IS NOT NULL OR "initiative_attachment"."vault_path" IS NOT NULL

issue_activity_owner_check.name: issue_activity_owner_check
issue_activity_owner_check.value: ("issue_activity"."issue_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("issue_activity"."initiative_id" IS NOT NULL)

issue_attachment_storage_check.name: issue_attachment_storage_check
issue_attachment_storage_check.value: "issue_attachment"."s3_key" IS NOT NULL OR "issue_attachment"."vault_path" IS NOT NULL

team_invite_project_role_check.name: team_invite_project_role_check
team_invite_project_role_check.value:
("team_invite"."project_id" IS NULL AND "team_invite"."project_role" IS NULL)
        OR ("team_invite"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "team_invite"."project_role" IN ('owner', 'member'))

pipeline_run_source_check.name: pipeline_run_source_check
pipeline_run_source_check.value:
("pipeline_run"."kind" = 'workflow') = ("pipeline_run"."pipeline_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pipeline_run"."version_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("pipeline_run"."kind" = 'workflow' OR "pipeline_run"."definition" IS NOT NULL)

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, coalesce(title, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, coalesce(title, '') || ' ' || translate(path, '/._-', '    ') || ' ' || coalesce(frontmatter ->> 'tags', '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('german'::regconfig, left(coalesce(text, ''), 100000)), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, left(coalesce(text, ''), 100000)), 'D')

helena_budget_target_check.name: helena_budget_target_check
